cases.name: Suspected lung toxicity independently interrupts

findings.text: Withhold while suspected ILD/pneumonitis is urgently evaluated. Arrange radiographic investigation, preferably CT, consider respiratory consultation and corticosteroids according to grade. Do not wait for the next routine scan.

cases.name: CrCl29.9 reconciles national and EMA disagreement

findings.text: NCCP expects no renal adjustment at CrCl<30 mL/min, but EMA says dose requirements cannot be determined because data are lacking. Reconcile with oncology/pharmacy; no automatic dose recommendation. Monitor carefully, especially for ILD.

cases.name: CrCl30 follows moderate-renal closer surveillance branch

findings.text: CrCl 30–<60 mL/min: no renal dose adjustment is required. EMA reports higher Grade 1–2 ILD incidence with moderate impairment; monitor carefully for respiratory symptoms and other toxicity.

cases.name: Bilirubin1.51 reconciles limited EMA dosing evidence

findings.text: Bilirubin >1.5×ULN: EMA cannot determine dose requirements due to limited data. Reconcile with NCCP hepatic categories and oncology/pharmacy; severe hepatic impairment is not recommended by NCCP. No automatic numeric dose is inferred.

cases.name: Severe liver impairment remains not recommended

findings.text: Severe hepatic impairment: trastuzumab deruxtecan is not recommended.
